observed.scope: Ratios of summed XP to summed recorded duration, not means of per-game rates. Includes drafting; version windows/drafts/teams differ. Marginal future XP cannot be inferred causally from historical pooled rates.

confounders: unequal time windows and sample sizes
rejected_shortcuts: treat every repeated command as waste
spend all gold without measuring opportunity cost

goal.primary: Improve individual integer XP score on both colors against exact khors:v114

productive_farm.measure: creep XP per alive field minute and last-hit opportunities

productive_engage.measure: hero XP minus expected death/recovery opportunity cost

safe_field_recall.measure: wasted home portals, interruptions, recovery time, resumed XP and score

range_aware_casting.measure: accepted effective casts, damage and XP; rejections secondary

profitable_extension.measure: extra XP minus200 per additional minute; do not idle to extend clock

economy_conversion.measure: net score gain from useful consumables or timely buyback, not raw gold spent

strategy.when: A public farming or safe hero-engagement opportunity is available and no immediate own-base emergency exists
strategy.comparison: Versus current strong structure target preference; required access-opening structures remain possible

strategy.when: A repeatable farming opportunity has expected marginal XP above200/minute with acceptable death risk
strategy.limits: No unconditional stalling, no inference from aggregate duration alone

strategy.when: A damaging spell is ready and the selected public target is within that current host ability range

execution.note: Do not merge into a controller before its own local drills and fresh hosted comparison.

priority: XP-producing target allocation and profitable duration
